text.p: Boston investment firm Bain Capital Partners is backing a tentative merger of Live Entertainment, Trimark Holdings and October Pictures, Daily Variety said, citing sources.
A merger would create a $200 million company with a 2,400-title library and distribution base, it said.
Daily Variety said a deal was far from finished, partly because other buyers, such as Universal Pictures, were interested in October Pictures.
Trimark was not immediately available to comment.
